user.title: Family Departures
user.description: Set up the household for departure planning.

abort.already_configured: Family Departures is already set up.

settings.title: Notification settings
settings.description: During development every notification can be routed to one test script.

data.dry_run: Dry run (log only, do not call scripts)

location_form.title: Location
location_form.description: A named place profiles and calendar links can go to.

data_description.aliases: Other names an event can use, for example in a 'plats:' tag or a calendar LOCATION.

calendar_form.title: Calendar
calendar_form.description: The ICS link holds a personal token and is stored securely. Leave it blank to keep the saved link. Persons selected below get this calendar as an extra link.

calendar_remove_confirm.title: Remove calendar
calendar_remove_confirm.description: Removing this calendar removes it from every profile that uses it and deletes its stored link. This cannot be undone.

remove_confirm.title: Remove profile
remove_confirm.description: Removing this profile deletes its settings and all its entities, and stops other profiles copying notices to it. Only this profile used: {unused}. Tick the box to remove those calendars (with their stored links) and locations too. This cannot be undone.

data.remove_unused: Remove the calendars and locations only this profile used

profile_person.title: Person
profile_person.description: The Home Assistant person this profile belongs to. It is used to match names in shared calendars.

profile_destination.title: Destination and travel mode
profile_destination.description: Choose a saved location, or type a name and pick a position to create a new one. Public-transport margins stay available even when the default mode is car.

data.static_minutes: Static travel minutes (bike/walk, door to door)
data.weather_adjust: Add a weather surcharge to the static time

profile_calendars.title: Calendars
profile_calendars.description: Link the calendars this profile follows and choose the main one (the school: the first event of the day sets the departure). Every other linked calendar becomes an activity calendar: each event is its own trip. Zero calendars is fine for a profile that only receives copies. A new calendar can be created below.

profile_link.title: Calendar link
profile_link.description: Settings for the link to {calendar} ({role}). Rules map a summary to a place or mode, one per line: IDRO => Sporthallen, or Simning => Badhuset, kollektivt.

data.label: Label
data.attendee_mode: Which events apply to this person
data.mode: Default travel mode for this link
data.match_event_location: Match the event's LOCATION against location aliases
data.show_summary: Show the event title in notices

profile_packing.title: Packing rule
profile_packing.description: Optional. A summary substring that triggers a packing item. {preview}

profile_notifications.title: Notifications and channels
profile_notifications.description: Channel scripts are optional so profiles without a phone can still be configured. Copies send this person's notice text to the selected profiles' phones. Copies are sent only while this profile's own notifications are enabled, even if it has no scripts.

data.lunch_in_digest: Include lunch in the evening summary

error.ics_required: An ICS link is required for this source type.
error.calendar_required: A calendar entity is required for this source type.
error.cannot_connect: The ICS link could not be fetched.
error.invalid_calendar: The response was not a valid calendar.
error.location_in_use: This location is used by a profile or a calendar link.
error.location_required: Choose a saved location or name a new one.
error.person_in_use: This person already belongs to another profile.
error.rules_invalid: Each rule must read 'text => place or mode', using a known location or mode.
error.duplicate_link: That calendar is already linked to this profile.
error.main_not_linked: The main calendar must be one of the linked calendars.

options.tagged_or_untagged: Untagged events and those naming this person

invalid_date.message: The date could not be parsed.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Recompute departure plans, optionally for a single person.

person_id.name: Person
person_id.description: Profile id to refresh. Leave empty to refresh everyone.

mark_departed.name: Mark departed
mark_departed.description: Close the current plan after a confirmed departure.

plan_id.name: Plan id
plan_id.description: The current plan id to close.

set_override.name: Set day override
set_override.description: Override transport mode, attendance or arrival time for a date.

date.name: Date
date.description: The local date the override applies to.

arrival_time.name: Arrival time
arrival_time.description: Replace the day's arrival requirement (local time).

date.name: Date
date.description: The local date whose override is removed.

get_alternatives.name: Get alternatives
get_alternatives.description: Return the reachable journeys for the current plan.

plan_id.name: Plan id
plan_id.description: Optional plan id of one of today's missions; defaults to the active mission.

select_journey.name: Select journey
select_journey.description: Record an explicitly chosen journey for the current plan.

reopen_today.name: Reopen today
reopen_today.description: Reopen today's mission after it was closed by a departure.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Mission slot to reopen; defaults to morning (the main mission).

invalid_source.title: Calendar {calendar} is not usable
invalid_source.description: The calendar {calendar} ({linked_profiles} linked profile(s)) could not be set up ({reason}). Open the integration options and set a valid ICS feed or calendar entity for this calendar.

missing_destination.title: Destination missing for {profile}
missing_destination.description: {profile} has no destination coordinates, so no travel time can be computed. Open the integration options and set the destination location for this profile.

repeated_fetch_failure.title: Calendar {calendar} keeps failing
repeated_fetch_failure.description: The calendar {calendar} ({linked_profiles} linked profile(s)) failed to load {failures} times in a row (last error: {error_code}). Check that the feed is reachable; the last cached schedule is used until it recovers.

profile_without_person.title: Profile {profile} has no linked person
profile_without_person.description: {profile} is not linked to a Home Assistant person entity, so it cannot be matched against attendee tags in shared calendars. Open the integration options and link a person to this profile.
